create_nut_sdf: create a signed distance function for a nut geometry using the nut function with a 3D point and plugin attributes
compute_nut_sdf_gradient: compute the gradient of the nut signed distance function at a 3D point using numerical differentiation
build_sdf_union: build a union of two signed distance fields using the Union function that returns the minimum of two values
build_sdf_intersection: build an intersection of two signed distance fields using the Intersection function that returns the maximum of two values
build_sdf_subtraction: build a subtraction of two signed distance fields using the Subtraction function that returns the max of a and negated b
